messages:
sophia: CSM ping  ZenithCare noticed an unexpected overage on INV-2026-1115. They bought a hybrid reserved pool with a soft-cap that should have absorbed brief spikes; invoice shows a burst overage line. Can ops/billing confirm?
harry: post the invoice rows and meter pointer pls.
sophia: snippet below (trimmed):
```
line_id,pool_label,region,hour_start,hour_end,gpu_hours,unit_rate
ZC-9001,hybrid-reserve-zenith,us-east-1,2026-11-02T08:00Z,2026-11-02T09:00Z,16.0,2.20
ZC-9002,burst-overage,us-east-1,2026-11-02T08:12Z,2026-11-02T08:20Z,1.5,4.00
```
billing-bot: Metering file: s3://exports/zenithcare/2026-11/meter-1102.csv sha1: e9b4a.
mike: ops context: customer purchased a hybrid pool (reserved+soft-cap) during sales negotiation. Soft-cap policy is implemented in router: it should prefer soft-cap capacity for spikes up to 20% usage. I see the router fell back to burst due to a mis-evaluated headroom calculation (off-by-one in available_slots calc) at 08:12 UTC. So the usage is real but should have been matched to their soft-cap.
harry: rough numbers: burst 1.5 gpu-hours * $4.00 = $6.00. Customer also missed soft-cap application across 16 gpu-hours at $2.20 vs discounted effective rate; need to check delta.
ara: sales/ops confirm the contract guaranteed soft-cap for spikes up to 20% of committed hours; for this hour 20% of 16 = 3.2 gpu-hours so the 1.5 burst should've been absorbed. So this is misbilling.
harry: propose immediate provisional credit CR-2026-901 for $6.00, and correct the committed discount attribution if needed (recompute invoice to reflect soft-cap apply). We'll also document root cause and open ENG-INC-4122 for the off-by-one in headroom calc. Approve?
sophia: approve. Please include a short customer note and ETA for credit.
accounting-bot: Policy: provisional credits < $100 can be issued by billing ops with CSM approval. GL: BILLING_CREDITS_SOFT_CAPS.
mike: I'll file the eng ticket and add a unit test to the headroom routine. ETA for patch: 24h. Also will run a backfill job to recompute affected hour buckets for their account (script in /ops/reconcile/softcap_backfill).
harry: applied provisional credit CR-2026-901 ($6.00) to INV-2026-1115; FIN ticket FIN-2026-789 created to track recalculation and audit. Notified accounting.
sophia: sending customer message now: "We found that a router calculation bug caused your soft-cap not to be applied for a brief spike; we've issued a $6.00 provisional credit while we recompute and audit; we'll follow up with final reconciliation within 5 business days"
ara: also want to offer a small goodwill: because they relied on the soft-cap promise, offer a 30-day trial of regional soft-cap pooling (no config change charge). Approve?
harry: finance ok for a trial offer; document under SALES_TRIALS. No billing credit required.
mike: eng note: patch rolled out to canary, unit test added, backfill job queued. Will post job ID when started.
ara: customer replied: thanked us and accepted the trial. asked if we can avoid these surprises in billing UI.
harry: action for product/docs: add explicit UI tooltip: "Soft-cap guarantees absorption for spikes up to X%" and surface a meter preview during checkout. I'll open DOC-REQ-1204.
sophia: final: provisional credit applied, ENG fix + backfill in progress, sales trial approved, docs request filed. I'll close once backfill audit completes and FIN-2026-789 reconciles. :white_check_mark:
